name: google-universal-cart-diode
title: Google Universal Cart & UCP Pre-Action Spend Diode
description: Sub-0.5ms PreToolUse execution firewall for agentic commerce. Prevents Gemini, Claude, and shopping bots from executing unauthorized purchases, duplicate checkouts, and runaway spend via Google Pay and the Universal Commerce Protocol.
author: ThumbGate

rules.message: Order total exceeds $100.00 ceiling. Operator override required.
Cumulative daily agent commerce spend exceeded $250.00 ceiling.
